title: What to tell a client who invested at a peak
objectives: Run the five peak-investor steps in order, starting with acknowledgement.
Fix real problems on a plan, never in panic.
body_md:
Acknowledge it: “Yes, you invested just before a fall. That's frustrating.” Check the horizon: if the goal is 7+ years away, time is on their side. Compare fairly: is the fund doing in line with its benchmark from the same date? Add, don't flee: if possible, continue SIPs or add gradually through the fall to lower the average cost. Fix real problems: if the money is needed soon, rebalance towards debt in a planned way rather than in panic.

- Acknowledge: “Yes, you invested just before a fall. That's frustrating.”
- Check the horizon: 7+ years away means time is on their side
- Compare fairly with the benchmark from the same date
- Add, don't flee: continue SIPs or add gradually
- Fix real problems on a plan, not in panic

> **Investor takeaway:** You can't control the date you started. You can control whether you stay, keep investing and stick to the plan.
example: ₹10 lakh invested last year, down 12%, goal 10 years away: acknowledge, confirm horizon, compare with benchmark, keep SIPs going, add gradually if comfortable.
say: Fix real problems on a plan, not in panic.
never: Predict when the market will recover.
